mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakness that depresses consumer confidence and corporate revenue, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market slowdown regime (HOUST < 1250), a concurrent decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1250 and RSAFS declines, or interaction Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates monetary tightening in a strong labor market, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE declines, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 100), a concurrent decline in industrial production growth signals weakening supply chain activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
